title: Phase 14 — Production Deployment Plan (20 steps, NOT executed) + Rollback Plan
preconditions: explicit NEW deploy authorization message from the product owner (this ticket is NOT one)
fresh triple backup verified immediately before (see backup-and-restore.json pattern)
deploymentSteps: 1. Announce maintenance window; confirm no in-flight critical report submissions.

2. Take a FRESH full backup: pg_dump -Fc reporting_prod + -Fp gz; tar publish, dist, env(0600), service unit, nginx conf, DataProtection-Keys; write SHA256SUMS; store in /opt/backups/prod-deploy-<ts>-r21 (0700).
3. Verify backup: pg_restore --list count > 0; sha256sum -c all non-secret files; (optionally) restore into a throwaway clone and compare migration/table/column counts to prod.
4. Snapshot current prod state: record git SHA (ce166662), publish tree sha256, `__EFMigrationsHistory` count(=30)+head, service PID, NRestarts, /health=200.

5. Capture DataProtection keyring state for www-data (KNOWN OPEN ITEM: prod www-data keyring not found in backup => provision a persistent key ring dir owned by www-data BEFORE cutover, else all active sessions invalidate on restart).
6. Pre-stage the config-only edit for /etc/reporting-api.env: add FileStorage__DocumentsRootPath=/var/lib/reporting/documents (create dir, chown www-data, 0750) — do NOT restart yet.

7. Run the Migration History Bridge in DRY-RUN against reporting_prod: Ops/MigrationHistoryBridge/bridge.sh --db reporting_prod --env production (no --apply). Confirm 9/9 pre-checks OK, exactly the 2 candidate-lineage IDs absent, full schema fingerprint MATCH.
8. Stop the service: systemctl stop reporting-api (START OF DOWNTIME).

9. Apply the bridge for real: bridge.sh --db reporting_prod --env production --apply --allow-production. Confirm +2 alias rows (history 30 -> 32), schema fingerprint UNCHANGED, rollback SQL auto-generated and saved.
10. Deploy backend: rsync --delete the staging publish/ (36d7f525) into /opt/reporting/publish; chown -R www-data:www-data; verify tree sha256 == 36d7f525.
11. Deploy frontend: rsync --delete the staging dist/ (165bdd1a) into /opt/reporting/reporting-frontend/dist; chown www-data; verify tree sha256 == 165bdd1a.
12. Apply the env edit from step 6 (FileStorage__DocumentsRootPath) now (file already prepared).
13. Start the service: systemctl start reporting-api. EF MigrateAsync applies the 10 additive migrations in ID order (history 32 -> 42). Watch journalctl for 'Applying migration' x10 and zero 42P07.
14. Wait for readiness: poll http://127.0.0.1:5090/health until 200 (END OF DOWNTIME).
15. Verify migration head: `__EFMigrationsHistory` count == 42, head 20260817114129_AddProjectExecutionUpdateProposals; zero errors in journal.
16. Smoke via nginx origin (https://reports.emarketingacademy.net): /health 200; unauth /api/clients 401; a real admin login 200; Project360 overview 200; Client360 200.
17. Document persistence check: upload a throwaway doc, confirm blob lands under /var/lib/reporting/documents (OUTSIDE publish), download matches, then remove the throwaway.
18. Browser smoke: load the SPA, confirm no console errors, no localhost/TEST/RC network calls, SignalR connects.
19. Confirm no external side-effects: EmailNotifications mode as intended; outbox not blasting; scheduler behaves per config.
20. Post-deploy: record new prod SHA (7e063b4), publish/dist hashes, migration head=42, health=200, service NRestarts; announce window closed; keep backup for the agreed retention.
(post) Fast-forward origin/main to the released SHA is a SEPARATE authorized git action, not part of the server cutover.

rollbackPlan.pointOfNoReturn: step 13 start (MigrateAsync writes 10 additive migrations). Before step 13, rollback = restart old artifact + delete the 2 bridge rows (auto-generated SQL). After step 13, forward DB has 42 migrations.
rollbackPlan.tier1_appArtifactOnly: if the app misbehaves but DB is intact and healthy: rsync the OLD publish (ce166662) + OLD dist back, revert the env edit, restart. SAFE because all 10 migrations are additive-only (ADD COLUMN/CREATE TABLE/CREATE INDEX, zero DROP) => the old code is schema-compatible with the forward (42) DB. Fastest rollback, no data loss.
rollbackPlan.tier2_fullRestore: if the DB is corrupted or migration aborts mid-way: systemctl stop; drop/recreate reporting_prod; pg_restore the pre-deploy -Fc dump; restore OLD publish/dist/env; restart old service; verify 30 migrations, 57 tables, health 200, row counts match backup. AUTHORITATIVE rollback (returns to exact pre-deploy state).
rollbackPlan.bridgeRollback: the bridge auto-generates DELETE-the-2-alias-rows SQL; only meaningful in the pre-step-13 window; after a forward migrate, tier2 full restore supersedes it.

decisionOwner.step_8_downtime_start: product owner / on-call lead sign-off required
decisionOwner.steps_9_15_migration: release engineer executes; DBA/lead on standby; abort->tier2 decision by on-call lead
decisionOwner.steps_16_20_verification: release engineer verifies; product owner confirms acceptance to close the window

rollbackPlan.ROLLBACK_READY: YES (proven: full DB restore verified on clone; migrations additive-only; bridge rollback SQL generated)

EXPECTED_DOWNTIME: ~2-5 minutes (service stop at step 8 -> health 200 at step 14). Dominated by the 10 additive migrations + app warmup; measured analog on the isolated rehearsal booted healthy with the same 10 migrations.
openItemsToCloseBeforeCutover: PROD-READINESS-01: config-only add FileStorage__DocumentsRootPath (proven closable on clone; NOT yet applied to prod).
DataProtection keyring for www-data not present in backup => provision persistent keyring before restart or accept one-time session invalidation.
